Improved metagenomic analysis with Kraken 2
Wood, Lu, Langmead. Genome Biology 2019.

Shotgun metagenomic reads were taxonomically classified with Kraken2 against a RefSeq database.
Kraken2 uses a compact hash table of minimizers to assign reads to the lowest common ancestor.
A Kraken2 report table was produced per sample. This is taxonomic profiling, not MAG binning.
